# investigate some dotfiles

Study well-known dotfiles repositories for ideas worth adopting; the list has a single unchecked entry, [mathiasbynens/dotfiles](https://github.com/mathiasbynens/dotfiles) — the most-starred macOS dotfiles, known for its `.macos` script of `defaults write` tweaks, its `brew.sh` and its aliases.
